run_autoresearch_engine: run the autoresearch engine with a workdir, pipeline script, and base launch command
resume_autoresearch_engine: resume a previously started autoresearch engine by passing only the workdir path
init_workdir: initialize a new experiment workdir with config, state, and master table headers
instrument_pipeline: instrument a pipeline script with TTFB and step-time logging using a coding agent
record_setup_failure: record a setup failure to the engine directory and persist it in state
